function.name: weather_forecast_get

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

message.content:
I don’t have access to real‑time clocks, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

1. **Check your device’s clock** – most smartphones and computers automatically adjust for daylight‑saving time and display the correct local time.  
2. **Use a reliable online source** – sites like timeanddate.com, worldtimebuddy.com, or the “Time” app on iOS/Android will show the current Eastern Time (ET) for New York City.  

If you’d like me to calculate an approximate time based on UTC, let me know!
